description:
List vulnerabilities from Vanta with optional severity, integration, and deactivation filters.

WORKFLOW:
- Start here to review open vulnerability posture.
- Use page_size and page_cursor for pagination.

RELATED TOOLS:
- vanta_get_vulnerability for full details on one vulnerability.

RETURNS:
- JSON with ok, vulnerabilities, count, and pageInfo.

integration_id.description: Filter by the Vanta integration ID that detected the vulnerability

is_deactivated.description: Filter by whether Vanta monitoring is deactivated for the vulnerability

page_cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response for the next page

page_size.description: Number of vulnerabilities to return, up to 100

severity.description: Filter by documented severity: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW

name: vanta_list_vulnerabilities
title: List Vanta Vulnerabilities
